lines.text: Match document ID + expected revision, write the title, increment the
revision. Success means one row changed. Every title writer must use
this contract; never reuse a revision, even after restoration.

texts.text:
Match document ID + expected revision, write the title, increment the
revision. Success means one row changed. Every title writer must use
this contract; never reuse a revision, even after restoration.

lines.text: After the conflict, show both versions.

texts.text: After the conflict, show both versions.

lines.text: Fetch revision 8. Let Omar keep Leena’s title, revise it, or deliberately
replace it. Any new save uses the fetched revision and can conflict
again. Never silently retry Omar’s stale title with a newer revision.

lines.text: Why atomic? Separate checks can both pass before either write.
Scope: one document; no deletion. This does not merge edits or make
multi-document changes atomic. A lost success response can look like
a later conflict: revision checks alone do not deduplicate requests.

Text block

Diagram
Nodes and connections for processes, systems and flows.
Chart
Bar, line, Sankey and other forms for the data you supply.
Image
Licensed pictures, brand marks and illustrations.
Table
Rows and columns derived from your content.
